chain.text:
**Established:** 60 cm reflector (2017); 20 cm refractor for outreach. 195 useful nights/year average; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn). ~400 GB/month, nightly 40-min transfer to Marseille university server.

**Changes:** Main camera replaced March 2025 (cooling failed twice); new sensor has 30% lower read noise. Firmware update pending; requires one full night offline. Timestamp offset of 1.2 s lost three weeks of photometry (Feb 2025); now GPS-checked each session.

**Failed/fixed:** 2023 dome motor seized; telescope hit dome wall, bending counterweight rod. Rod replaced, limit switch added.

**Rules:** No runs during outreach evenings (2023 cause). Raw frames never deleted; compressed after two years. Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Open:** Spanish simultaneous-observation collaboration (proposed 2025) depends on unevaluated shared scheduling tool; network link capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
